beginner.summary: No cloud experience assumed. Participants learn the core AWS services for compute, storage, networking, databases, identity and monitoring, and deploy a small web application.
prerequisites: Basic computer and networking knowledge (IP address, DNS, web browser)
An AWS account or trainer-provided sandbox account with a budget alert
outcomes: Explain cloud computing, AWS global infrastructure and the shared responsibility model
Launch and secure EC2 instances, S3 buckets, RDS databases and a VPC
Control access with IAM users, groups, roles and policies
Deploy, monitor and cost-control a simple web application on AWS

days.topic: Cloud Computing Concepts and the AWS Global Infrastructure
subtopics: What cloud computing is: on-demand, pay-as-you-go
Regions, Availability Zones and edge locations
AWS account setup and the root user
Turning on MFA for the root user
Billing dashboard and the Free Tier
days.lab_task: Secure a new AWS account: enable MFA on the root user, create a monthly budget of 10 USD with an email alert, and choose a home Region with a written reason.
days.deliverable: Screenshots of root MFA enabled and the budget alert, plus a one-paragraph Region choice note
checks: A 10 USD monthly budget with an email alert exists
Ask: who patches the EC2 guest OS?
Participant answers the customer, citing the shared responsibility model
objectives: Explain cloud service and deployment models
Describe Regions, AZs and the shared responsibility model
Secure and cost-protect a new AWS account

days.topic: IAM Users, Groups and Policies
subtopics: Why not to use the root user
Reading a JSON policy: Effect, Action, Resource
Password policy and MFA for users
Access keys and when to avoid them
days.lab_task: Create Admins and Developers groups, an admin user with MFA, and a developer user that can only read S3; prove the developer cannot delete a bucket.
days.deliverable: IAM setup screenshots and the AccessDenied result from the developer's delete attempt
checks: Developer runs aws s3 rb on a bucket
Explain each line of the developer policy
Effect, Action and Resource are explained correctly
objectives: Create IAM users and groups with MFA

days.topic: EC2 Instances and Key Pairs
subtopics: Key pairs and SSH or Session Manager access
On-Demand, Spot and Savings Plans pricing
days.lab_task: Launch an Amazon Linux instance with a user data script that installs a web server, allow HTTP only from your IP, and show the web page.
days.deliverable: Running instance details, security group rules and a screenshot of the web page
checks: Browse to the instance public IP
Web page from the user data script loads
Browse from a different network or IP
Connection is blocked by the security group
Participant explains why the public IP changed
Before and after IPs with explanation
objectives: Launch and connect to EC2 instances

days.topic: EBS Volumes, Snapshots and AMIs
subtopics: EBS volume types: gp3, io2, st1
Restoring a volume from a snapshot
days.lab_task: Attach an encrypted gp3 volume, write a test file, snapshot it, delete the volume, restore it from the snapshot and confirm the file is intact.
days.deliverable: Command log and screenshots of each step with the restored file contents
checks: Read the test file on the restored volume
Encryption shows enabled with a KMS key
Launch a new instance from your custom AMI
objectives: Create, attach and back up EBS volumes

days.topic: Amazon S3 Storage
days.lab_task: Create a versioned bucket with Block Public Access on, upload and overwrite a file, restore the old version, add a lifecycle rule, and share one object with a 15-minute pre-signed URL.
days.deliverable: Bucket configuration screenshots, version history and the pre-signed URL test results
checks: Open the object URL without a pre-signed link
Open the pre-signed URL within 15 minutes
objectives: Store and protect data in S3
Share objects safely with pre-signed URLs

days.topic: VPC Networking: Subnets and Route Tables
subtopics: Network ACLs compared with security groups
days.lab_task: Build a VPC with public and private subnets in two AZs, an Internet Gateway and a NAT Gateway; place a web instance in public and an app instance in private.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, route table screenshots and connectivity test results
checks: From the private instance, run curl to a public website
From the internet, try to reach the private instance
Remove the NAT route and retry from the private instance
Outbound access fails, and the participant explains why
objectives: Design a VPC with public and private subnets
Route traffic with Internet and NAT Gateways

days.topic: Elastic Load Balancing and Auto Scaling
subtopics: Application Load Balancer, listeners and target groups
Auto Scaling groups: desired, min and max
days.lab_task: Put two web instances behind an ALB using an Auto Scaling group across two AZs, then terminate one instance and watch it get replaced.
days.deliverable: ALB and Auto Scaling configuration, plus a timeline of the replacement
checks: Refresh the ALB DNS name several times
Auto Scaling launches a replacement and the site stays up
objectives: Distribute traffic with an Application Load Balancer
Keep capacity healthy with Auto Scaling

days.topic: Amazon RDS Relational Databases
days.lab_task: Create a MySQL RDS instance in private subnets, allow access only from the app security group, create a table and restore a point-in-time copy.
days.deliverable: RDS configuration, connection test and point-in-time restore evidence
checks: Connection succeeds and a query returns rows
Connection fails because the database is private
Restore to a time before a row was deleted

days.topic: Amazon DynamoDB NoSQL
subtopics: When to choose DynamoDB or RDS
days.lab_task: Design an Orders table with a customer partition key and order-date sort key, load sample data, and query a customer's orders for one month.
days.deliverable: Table design note, CLI commands and query results
checks: Only that customer's March orders return
Compare the same lookup with Scan
Participant shows Scan reads far more items
Add a GSI on order status and query pending orders
Pending orders return from the index
objectives: Model data with partition and sort keys

days.topic: Route 53 and CloudFront
days.lab_task: Serve the S3 static website through CloudFront over HTTPS with origin access control, and create a weighted Route 53 record split 80/20 between two endpoints.
days.deliverable: CloudFront and Route 53 configuration plus test results
checks: Open the site through the CloudFront URL
Open the S3 object URL directly
Access denied because only CloudFront can read the bucket
objectives: Explain DNS and Route 53 routing policies
Deliver content through CloudFront with HTTPS

days.topic: CloudWatch Monitoring and Alarms
subtopics: CloudWatch agent for memory and disk
days.lab_task: Install the CloudWatch agent on the web server, ship its access log, create a 404-count metric filter, and alarm by email when CPU stays above 70% for 5 minutes.
days.deliverable: Dashboard screenshot, alarm configuration and the received alarm email
checks: Run a CPU stress test for 6 minutes
Alarm goes to ALARM and an email arrives
Run a Logs Insights query for the top client IPs
objectives: Collect metrics and logs with CloudWatch

days.topic: AWS CLI and Scripting
days.lab_task: Write a script that lists all running EC2 instances in a Region with their Name tag and type, and stops those tagged Environment=dev.
days.deliverable: Script, its output and a before-and-after instance state list
checks: Run the script on the lab account
Lists instances with Name and type in a table
They are stopped; others keep running
Run with an invalid profile name
Script exits with a clear error
objectives: Configure and use the AWS CLI

days.topic: AWS Lambda Serverless Functions
days.lab_task: Create a Lambda function triggered by uploads to an S3 bucket that writes the file name, size and upload time to a DynamoDB table.
days.deliverable: Function code, IAM role policy and DynamoDB items for three uploads
checks: Three matching items appear in DynamoDB
Remove DynamoDB write permission from the role and upload again
Function fails with AccessDenied in the logs
Item is written with size 0 without errors

days.topic: API Gateway with Lambda
days.lab_task: Build an HTTP API with GET /notes and POST /notes backed by Lambda and DynamoDB, with throttling set to 5 requests per second.
days.deliverable: API definition, function code and curl test results
objectives: Expose Lambda functions through API Gateway
Validate requests and return correct status codes

days.topic: Messaging with SQS and SNS
subtopics: Fan-out from SNS to several SQS queues
days.lab_task: Publish order events to an SNS topic that fans out to an email subscription and an SQS queue processed by Lambda, with a dead-letter queue for failures.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, configuration and test evidence
checks: Email arrives and Lambda processes the queue message
Publish a malformed event that the function rejects
Message lands in the dead-letter queue after the retry limit
Explain visibility timeout using the logs
Participant explains why a slow function caused a repeat delivery
objectives: Decouple services with queues and topics
Fan out messages to several consumers

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with CloudFormation
days.lab_task: Write a CloudFormation template for a versioned S3 bucket and a Lambda function with its role, deploy it, update it through a change set, and detect manual drift.
days.deliverable: Template file, change set screenshot and drift detection result
checks: Add a bad property and update
Update fails and rolls back to the previous state
Change the bucket tags in the console and run drift detection
Drift is reported on the bucket
objectives: Update stacks safely with change sets

days.topic: Containers on AWS: ECR and ECS Fargate
subtopics: ECS clusters, task definitions and services
Service behind an Application Load Balancer
days.lab_task: Containerise a small web app, push it to ECR, run it as an ECS Fargate service with two tasks behind an ALB, then deploy a new version with a rolling update.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, task definition, service configuration and deployment evidence
checks: App version 1 responds from two tasks
Rolling update completes with no failed requests during the deploy
objectives: Deploy new versions with rolling updates

days.topic: Cloud Security Services: KMS, Secrets Manager and CloudTrail
subtopics: Encryption at rest and in transit
days.lab_task: Move the database password into Secrets Manager, read it from the app at start-up, enable a CloudTrail trail, and add an AWS Config rule that flags unencrypted EBS volumes.
days.deliverable: Updated app configuration, trail settings and the Config compliance report
checks: Search the app code and environment for the password
Password is not present; the app reads it from Secrets Manager
Find who deleted a test bucket
CloudTrail shows the user, time and API call

days.topic: Cost Management and the Well-Architected Framework
days.lab_task: Tag all lab resources by project, find the three most expensive resources in Cost Explorer, propose savings, and run a Well-Architected review of the course web app.
days.deliverable: Cost report with savings proposals and the Well-Architected review summary
checks: Filter Cost Explorer by the project tag
Shows costs for lab resources only
Includes current cost, proposed change and estimated saving
At least three risks with an improvement for each
objectives: Review a workload against best practices

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Highly Available Web Application on AWS
subtopics: VPC, ALB and Auto Scaling design
S3 and CloudFront for static files
days.lab_task: Deploy a two-tier web application across two Availability Zones with an ALB, Auto Scaling, a private RDS database, static files on CloudFront, alarms and a budget, then present it.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, deployed application, monitoring dashboard, monthly cost estimate and a 10-minute demo
checks: Terminate an instance during the demo
Site stays available and the instance is replaced
Try to reach the database from the internet
Connection fails because it is private
Monthly estimate is calculated with the Pricing Calculator and matches the design
objectives: Design and deploy a highly available web application
Apply networking, security and monitoring basics together
Present an architecture with its cost

intermediate.summary: For participants who have used core AWS services. Covers multi-account setup, advanced networking, Terraform and CDK, containers on EKS, serverless patterns, data services, CI/CD and operations.
prerequisites: Has deployed EC2, S3, VPC, RDS and IAM resources on AWS
Comfortable with the AWS CLI and reading JSON policies
Basic Linux command line, Git and Docker
outcomes: Set up a governed multi-account AWS environment
Build infrastructure with Terraform and the AWS CDK
Run containers on EKS and serverless workflows with Step Functions and EventBridge
Deliver workloads through CI/CD with monitoring, tracing and cost controls

days.topic: Multi-Account Structure with AWS Organizations and IAM Identity Center
subtopics: Organizations, OUs and the management account
IAM Identity Center users and permission sets
days.lab_task: Create dev and prod accounts in OUs, apply an SCP that blocks leaving the organisation and disabling CloudTrail, and give developers read-only access to prod through Identity Center.
days.deliverable: OU structure, SCP JSON and access test evidence
checks: Developer signs in to prod through Identity Center
Can view but not change resources
Try to stop the CloudTrail trail in dev as an admin
Assume the cross-account role from the CLI
Temporary credentials work in the target account
objectives: Structure accounts with Organizations and OUs
Apply guardrails with service control policies
Manage access centrally with IAM Identity Center

days.topic: IAM Policy Design: Conditions, Boundaries and Roles
subtopics: IAM roles for EC2 and Lambda
days.lab_task: Implement tag-based access so developers can only start and stop instances tagged with their team, under a permission boundary, and prove it with the policy simulator.
days.deliverable: Policies, boundary, simulator results and a short explanation of the evaluation order
checks: Team A developer stops a Team A instance
Team A developer stops a Team B instance
Developer tries to create a role without the boundary
objectives: Use conditions and tags for fine-grained access

days.topic: Advanced VPC: Peering, Transit Gateway and PrivateLink
subtopics: Transit Gateway hubs and route tables
IP address planning for many VPCs
days.lab_task: Connect three VPCs through a Transit Gateway, add an S3 gateway endpoint so private subnets reach S3 without NAT, and use Flow Logs to find rejected traffic.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, route tables, endpoint policy and Flow Log analysis
checks: Ping between instances in VPC A and VPC C
Upload to S3 from a private subnet with the NAT removed
Query Flow Logs for REJECT records
Identifies the blocked source and port
objectives: Reach AWS services privately with endpoints

days.topic: Terraform for AWS
subtopics: Remote state in S3 with locking
Workspaces or separate state per environment
terraform fmt, validate and plan review
days.lab_task: Write a reusable Terraform module for a VPC with public and private subnets, store state remotely in S3 with locking, and deploy it to dev and prod with different CIDRs.
days.deliverable: Module code, environment configurations and plan and apply outputs
checks: Run terraform plan with no changes
Run apply from two terminals at once
Second run waits or fails on the state lock
Change a subnet CIDR and run plan
Plan shows the replacement and the participant explains its impact

days.topic: AWS CDK with Python
subtopics: CDK compared with Terraform and CloudFormation
days.lab_task: Build a CDK app in Python that deploys an API Gateway, Lambda and DynamoDB stack, and write assertion tests that require encryption and point-in-time recovery on the table.
days.deliverable: CDK project, synthesized template and passing tests
checks: Run cdk diff after changing the Lambda memory
Remove point-in-time recovery and run the tests
objectives: Define infrastructure in Python with the CDK
Choose between CDK, Terraform and CloudFormation

days.topic: Amazon EKS Clusters
subtopics: EKS architecture: control plane and nodes
Managed node groups and Fargate profiles
kubectl access and the aws-auth or access entries
days.lab_task: Create an EKS cluster with a managed node group, deploy a web app exposed through the AWS Load Balancer Controller, and give a pod read access to S3 through IAM roles for service accounts.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, Kubernetes manifests and access test results
checks: From the pod, list the allowed S3 bucket
Succeeds without access keys in the pod
From a pod without the service account, list the bucket
objectives: Expose services through AWS load balancers
Grant pods AWS permissions without keys

days.topic: Serverless Workflows with Step Functions and EventBridge
subtopics: Task, Choice, Parallel and Map states
days.lab_task: Build an order workflow in Step Functions (validate, charge, reserve stock, notify) triggered by an EventBridge rule, with retries and a compensation step when charging fails.
days.deliverable: State machine definition, EventBridge rule and execution history for success and failure
checks: Make the charge step fail twice then succeed
Compensation step runs and stock is released

days.topic: Data Services: Aurora, ElastiCache and S3 Data Lakes
subtopics: S3 data lake layout and partitions
AWS Glue Data Catalog and crawlers
days.lab_task: Add Redis caching in front of an Aurora query, measure the latency change, and load application logs into an S3 data lake queried with Athena.
days.deliverable: Latency comparison, cache configuration and three Athena query results
checks: Second call is served from Redis with lower latency
Cache is invalidated and the new value returns
Run an Athena query on one day's partition
objectives: Query an S3 data lake with Athena

days.topic: CI/CD on AWS with CodePipeline and GitHub Actions
subtopics: GitHub Actions with OIDC to AWS
days.lab_task: Create a GitHub Actions pipeline that authenticates to AWS with OIDC (no stored keys), builds and pushes an image to ECR, and deploys to ECS with a manual approval for prod.
days.deliverable: Workflow file, IAM OIDC role trust policy and two pipeline runs
checks: Search the repository secrets for AWS access keys
None are stored; OIDC is used
Image is built, pushed and deployed to dev
Prod is updated only after approval
objectives: Authenticate pipelines with OIDC instead of keys

days.topic: Deployment Strategies: Blue/Green and Canary on AWS
days.lab_task: Deploy a Lambda function with a 10% canary for 5 minutes tied to an error alarm, and show automatic rollback when the new version returns errors.
days.deliverable: Deployment configuration and evidence of one successful and one rolled-back deployment
checks: Deploy a version that returns errors
Alarm fires and traffic rolls back automatically
Explain how the database schema change was made safe

days.topic: Observability with CloudWatch, X-Ray and OpenTelemetry
days.lab_task: Instrument the order workflow with structured logs, a custom orders-per-minute metric and X-Ray tracing, add a Synthetics canary, and build a service dashboard.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, service map screenshot and canary results
checks: X-Ray shows one trace through API Gateway, Lambda and DynamoDB
Canary fails and the alarm fires
All log lines for that order are returned
objectives: Instrument services with logs, metrics and traces

days.topic: Workload Security: WAF, Shield and Security Hub
subtopics: AWS WAF web ACLs and managed rules
Macie for sensitive data in S3
days.lab_task: Protect the API with AWS WAF managed rules and a rate limit, enable Security Hub with the foundational standard, and fix the three highest-severity findings.
days.deliverable: WAF configuration, test results and before and after Security Hub scores
checks: Send a SQL injection test string to the API
Send 500 requests a minute from one IP
Score improves after fixing three findings

days.topic: Backup, Disaster Recovery and Multi-Region Design
subtopics: DR strategies: backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, active-active
days.lab_task: Set RPO and RTO for the web app, implement pilot-light DR in a second Region with cross-Region backups and Route 53 failover, and run a timed failover test.
days.deliverable: DR plan with RPO and RTO, configuration and the failover test timeline
checks: Route 53 sends traffic to the second Region
Compare measured recovery time with the RTO
Measured time is within the RTO or the gap is explained
Restore yesterday's backup in the second Region
objectives: Define RPO and RTO for a workload
Implement a DR strategy across Regions

days.topic: Systems Manager for Operations
days.lab_task: Remove SSH access from the fleet, patch all dev instances with Patch Manager in a maintenance window, and write an Automation runbook that restarts the web service and checks health.
days.deliverable: Patch compliance report, runbook document and execution history
checks: Connect to an instance with port 22 closed
Open patch compliance after the window
Service restarts and the health check passes

days.topic: Cost Optimisation for Running Workloads
days.lab_task: Reduce the monthly cost of the course workload by at least 30%: move suitable compute to Graviton or Spot, tune Lambda memory, and apply S3 Intelligent-Tiering, measuring before and after.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis with before and after estimates and the changes made
checks: Compare the before and after cost estimates
Reduction of at least 30% or a documented reason
Run Lambda Power Tuning on one function
Chosen memory setting is justified by cost and duration
Interrupt a Spot instance in the test
objectives: Measure costs per unit of work
Apply compute, storage and serverless cost savings

days.topic: Hybrid Connectivity and Migration Services
days.lab_task: Migrate a simulated on-premises MySQL database to RDS with DMS using full load and ongoing replication, then cut over with less than 5 minutes of write downtime.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, DMS task configuration and cut-over timeline
checks: Compare row counts after the full load
Write new rows to the source during replication
Rows appear in the target within one minute

days.topic: Event Streaming with Kinesis and MSK
subtopics: Kinesis Data Streams shards and retention
days.lab_task: Stream clickstream events into Kinesis, compute per-minute page views with a Lambda consumer into DynamoDB, and archive raw events to S3 with Firehose.
days.deliverable: Pipeline diagram, consumer code and results for a 10-minute replay
checks: Per-minute counts match the trainer's expected totals
Raw events are stored in time-partitioned folders
Consumer handles them idempotently and counts stay correct

days.topic: Governance with Control Tower and Tagging Strategy
subtopics: Enforcing tags with tag policies and Config
days.lab_task: Define a tagging standard, enforce it with a tag policy and an AWS Config rule across accounts, and report non-compliant resources from the audit account.
days.deliverable: Tagging standard document, policies and the compliance report
checks: Create a resource without required tags
Use an invalid value for the cost-centre tag
CloudTrail logs from all accounts are present
objectives: Govern many accounts with Control Tower

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Serverless Order Platform on AWS
days.lab_task: Build a serverless order platform with an API, a Step Functions workflow, event notifications, WAF protection, infrastructure as code and a canary deployment pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, architecture diagram, dashboard, cost estimate and a 15-minute demo
checks: Order completes and a notification event is published
Deploy a faulty version through the pipeline
Canary detects errors and rolls back
Destroy and recreate the stack from code
Environment is rebuilt with no manual steps
objectives: Design and build a serverless platform end to end
Combine infrastructure as code, CI/CD, security and monitoring

advanced.summary: For experienced AWS engineers. Covers enterprise architecture, multi-Region resilience, security at scale, platform engineering, FinOps, large-scale Kubernetes and serverless, and architecture reviews.
prerequisites: Two or more years building and operating workloads on AWS
Has used infrastructure as code, CI/CD and containers in production
Solutions Architect - Associate level knowledge or equivalent experience
outcomes: Design multi-account, multi-Region AWS architectures that meet stated reliability and security goals
Build internal platforms and guardrails that teams can self-serve
Run security, cost and reliability programmes with measurable results
Lead architecture reviews and justify trade-offs with evidence

days.topic: Enterprise Landing Zone Design
subtopics: Account and OU strategy for large organisations
Identity federation with an external identity provider
Migrating existing accounts into the landing zone
days.lab_task: Design a landing zone for a company with 3 business units and 40 workload accounts, then automate account creation with Account Factory for Terraform including baseline networking and guardrails.
days.deliverable: Landing zone design document, automation code and a newly vended account
checks: Vend a new account through the pipeline
Account is created with baseline network, logging and guardrails
Each OU has a stated purpose and policy set
Exception process is documented and time-limited
objectives: Design an enterprise account and network structure

days.topic: Multi-Region Active-Active Architecture
subtopics: When active-active is worth the cost
days.lab_task: Build an active-active API in two Regions with DynamoDB global tables and latency routing, then simulate a Region failure and measure impact on writes and reads.
days.deliverable: Architecture decision record, deployment and the failure test report
checks: Write the same item in both Regions at once
Conflict is resolved as documented and the participant explains the rule
Traffic moves to the other within the stated time
Read the cost section of the decision record
Extra cost versus single-Region is quantified

days.topic: Resilience Engineering and Chaos Testing with AWS FIS
subtopics: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
days.lab_task: Run three FIS experiments (AZ power loss on EC2, API throttling, increased latency) against the course service with stop conditions, and fix one weakness each experiment reveals.
days.deliverable: Experiment templates, results and the resilience improvements made
checks: Service stays within its error budget
Rerun an experiment after the fix
Measured impact is lower than before
objectives: Design for failure with cells and static stability

days.topic: Security at Scale: Detection, Response and Forensics
subtopics: Automated response with EventBridge and Lambda
days.lab_task: Automate response to a simulated compromised EC2 instance: isolate it, snapshot its volumes for forensics, revoke its role sessions, and notify the security team.
days.deliverable: Response automation code, runbook and the incident timeline
checks: Snapshots are created and tagged with the finding ID
Use the old role credentials after response

days.topic: Data Protection and Encryption Architecture
subtopics: KMS key hierarchy and multi-Region keys
Customer managed versus AWS managed keys
days.lab_task: Design key separation for three data classes, share encrypted S3 data with a partner account using a key policy and grant, and prove a deleted-key safeguard works.
days.deliverable: Encryption design, key policies and access test results
checks: Partner account reads the shared object
Partner reads an object of another data class
Alarm fires on the scheduled deletion event
objectives: Share encrypted data across accounts safely

days.topic: Zero-Trust Networking on AWS
days.lab_task: Replace a VPN for an internal app with Verified Access, connect two services through VPC Lattice with IAM auth policies, and block outbound traffic to unapproved domains.
days.deliverable: Network design, policies and access test results
checks: Access the internal app as a user without the required group
Call service B from an unauthorised service
Resolve an unapproved domain from a workload
objectives: Apply zero-trust access to users and services

days.topic: Platform Engineering with Service Catalog and Golden Paths
days.lab_task: Build a golden-path template that creates a containerised service with repository, pipeline, infrastructure, monitoring and alarms in one self-service request.
days.deliverable: Template code, a service created from it and a platform scorecard
checks: Create a new service from the template
Repository, pipeline, infrastructure and dashboard exist and the service deploys
Request a non-approved instance type through the template
Under the target time stated in the scorecard
objectives: Design internal platforms around golden paths

days.topic: EKS at Scale: Multi-Tenancy and Karpenter
subtopics: Cluster topology: shared or per-team clusters
days.lab_task: Configure a multi-tenant EKS cluster for three teams with quotas, network policies and Pod Identity, and replace managed node groups with Karpenter using Spot and Graviton.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, tenant policies and a cost and scaling comparison
checks: Team A pod calls a Team B service
Karpenter adds suitable nodes within minutes

days.topic: GitOps and Progressive Delivery on EKS
days.lab_task: Manage two EKS clusters with Argo CD ApplicationSets and release a service with an Argo Rollouts canary that promotes or aborts based on Prometheus error-rate analysis.
days.deliverable: GitOps repository, rollout definitions and two release histories
checks: Analysis fails and the rollout aborts

days.topic: Serverless at Scale: Concurrency, Cold Starts and Limits
days.lab_task: Load test the order API to 2,000 requests per second, find the first limit hit, and redesign with queues, provisioned concurrency and idempotency until it meets the latency target.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, the limits found and the redesign with results
checks: Run the load test before the redesign
First limit is identified with evidence
p99 latency meets the stated target
objectives: Find and handle serverless scaling limits

days.topic: Event-Driven Architecture Patterns at Enterprise Scale
subtopics: Event schemas and the EventBridge schema registry
days.lab_task: Implement the outbox pattern with DynamoDB Streams and EventBridge across two accounts, version an event schema without breaking consumers, and replay a day of events.
days.deliverable: Architecture, code, schema versions and replay evidence
checks: Fail the publisher after the database write
Event is still delivered later through the outbox

days.topic: Data Architecture: Lakehouse and Analytics Platforms
days.lab_task: Build a lakehouse with Iceberg tables, column-level Lake Formation permissions and a Glue job with data quality rules, and compare query cost in Athena and Redshift Serverless.
days.deliverable: Lakehouse design, permissions, job code, data quality results and the cost comparison
checks: Access is denied by Lake Formation
Load a batch that breaks a quality rule
Job stops or quarantines the bad rows as designed
Iceberg time travel returns the earlier data
objectives: Design a governed lakehouse on AWS
Compare analytics engines by cost and speed

days.topic: FinOps Practice on AWS
subtopics: Cost allocation with tags and accounts
days.lab_task: Build a chargeback report per business unit from Cost and Usage Reports in Athena and QuickSight, define a cost per order unit metric, and plan a Savings Plans purchase.
days.deliverable: Chargeback dashboard, unit cost metric and a commitment purchase recommendation
checks: Compare chargeback totals with the bill

days.topic: Compliance Automation and Audit Readiness
subtopics: Policy as code with cfn-guard or OPA
days.lab_task: Map 10 controls from a chosen framework to Config rules and pipeline checks, add automated remediation for two, and produce an audit evidence report.
days.deliverable: Control mapping, rules, remediation code and the evidence report
checks: Push a template that breaks a policy-as-code rule

days.topic: Performance Engineering for AWS Workloads
days.lab_task: Bring a slow API from 900 ms to under 200 ms p95 at the target load using Performance Insights, RDS Proxy and caching, documenting each change and its measured effect.
days.deliverable: Performance report with each change and its effect, and the final load test
checks: p95 under 200 ms at target load
Show the top SQL before and after
Worst query is fixed with evidence
RDS Proxy keeps the app working

days.topic: Generative AI Workloads on Amazon Bedrock
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant over the course runbooks with Bedrock Knowledge Bases, guardrails that block personal data, private network access, and an evaluation set of 20 questions.
days.deliverable: Assistant code, guardrail configuration and the evaluation results
checks: Accuracy meets the stated threshold with sources cited
Ask it to reveal a phone number from the documents
Call Bedrock from outside the VPC endpoint policy

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration and Modernisation Strategy
days.lab_task: Produce a migration plan for a 60-application portfolio: classify each with the 7 Rs, plan three waves with dependencies, and write the business case for wave 1.
days.deliverable: Portfolio analysis, wave plan and business case
checks: No application moves before the applications it depends on
Includes costs, savings, risks and payback period

days.topic: SRE Practice: SLOs, Error Budgets and Incident Command
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for the order API, set multi-window burn-rate alarms, and run a 60-minute incident simulation with assigned roles followed by a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: SLO document, alarm configuration, incident timeline and the review
checks: Inject errors that burn 10% of the budget in an hour
Roles, decisions and customer updates are recorded
Has root cause and at least three action items with owners
objectives: Lead incidents and learn from them

days.topic: Architecture Reviews and Trade-off Decisions
days.lab_task: Review another team's capstone design using the Well-Architected Tool and a lens, write two architecture decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute recommendation presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Lists options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Participant defends it with cost and risk evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Region Enterprise Platform on AWS
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-Region platform for a regulated client, including landing zone, workloads, security automation, DR and cost model, then defend it in an architecture review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working deployment, test evidence for security and DR, cost model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Recovery meets the stated RTO and RPO
Monthly cost is broken down and reconciles with the Pricing Calculator
objectives: Design an enterprise-grade AWS platform end to end
Prove reliability, security and cost with evidence
Defend architecture decisions to a review board
